phase: P1 fourth increment: immutable plan protection, frozen exits and verified settlement
implemented: Shared lifecycle selector includes legacy S6/S8 and any present strategy_plan marker, including malformed markers; opening dispatch selection is intentionally not expanded.

Native protection binds original immutable plan, full OPEN quantity and scoped intent; entry expiry or OFF/DRAINING deployment does not cancel historical management obligations. Ambiguous stop responses retain the same request identity.

Frozen risk-trail/v1 software exit uses explicit R/partial/trail/optional-duration settings. Unsupported handlers never fall back to legacy scoring; unprotected emergency reduction does not depend on the software handler.
Remaining risk is allocated from the original full-plan quantity, partial-take-profit fills are not repeated after cancellation, and quantity dust is not submitted as an invalid partial order.
Typed cash journal and settlement source require cash-basis-v2 and exact immutable provenance; no new legacy precision-correction bridge or risk-release tolerance.
Transaction-level settlement rereads the original plan and verified cash, inventory, fills, fees, funding and ledger revision; rollback and duplicate recovery retain the existing financial authority.

Typed immutable outcome journal records actual plan, net result, costs, duration and exit evidence without a fabricated legacy quality_score. Confirmed maintenance closures are excluded from strategy learning.

Outcome analysis failure does not undo committed settlement or released risk. Pending completion checks original history and current settlement identity; a non-authoritative in-memory round-robin cursor prevents repeated bad analysis from owning every batch.

Capital compounding and recovery probes batch-read only recognized current-revision verified settlements with exact new-plan provenance. Additional cash facts make stale settlement profits ineligible until verified again.
Health and settlement entry projections understand persisted typed outcomes without pretending they are legacy quality-score records.

qa.boundary: Disposable PostgreSQL/Redis over Unix sockets; V2 conftest blocks external TCP. No running trading database or real exchange call.
qa.scope: 73 selected lifecycle/capital/compatibility/fault regression files; not the entire repository, real Binance Testnet acceptance or profitability evidence.

intermediate_runs.note: Fixture created unreserved legacy exposure before enabling risk; replaced with legitimate reserved history, without bypassing guards.
Fixed invalid test handler identifier, incomplete partial ACK evidence and missing confirmed-maintenance binding; retained all production checks.
Two tests constructed unsupported account-scope values; now assert rejection separately and test valid cross-account/environment exclusion.
Same-plan BUY/SELL fake-venue management cycle, verified settlement and capital cases; more cases added afterwards.
Full selected regression caught old __new__ test doubles missing connect/plan-reader and outcome-cursor interfaces. Updated two fixtures only, preserving precision and financial-isolation assertions.

focused_regression.note: Six new files plus both corrected legacy fixtures. The final 73-file run also covers the last faithful legacy snapshot-shape correction.

independent_review: Protection/exit and cash/settlement cross-reviewed; outcome identity and starvation findings fixed. Final review found no remaining blocking P1/P2 findings for this increment. Corrected legacy test fixtures retain all original assertions.

read_only_service_observation.scope: Service metadata only; no fresh claim about exchange positions.

remaining_before_activation: Independent management scheduling that cannot be blocked by strategy/model computations.
New opportunity worker, auditable terminal signal decisions and actual new OPEN authorization/readiness/baseline wiring.
Deployment, crash/restart recovery and resource-load acceptance of the complete new pipeline; only fake venue management has been exercised here.
Typed outcome dashboard/research projections without inventing legacy quality scores.
Only one full-quantity OPEN request per episode; no additional entries, atomic risk top-up or exact partial-allocation adapter.
Reference frozen exit is an engineering contract, not a validated profitable strategy. P2 strategy comparison and out-of-sample evidence remain.
profitability_claim: None. These tests verify engineering contracts and financial invariants, not edge or real venue execution quality.
